_comment: Station congruence screen (docs/SPEC_redundancy_census.md) — ON arm of the
first WIRING smoke.  Inherits _ft63_redund_on.json verbatim (63 stations,
GPS, 300 s, redundancy census at stride 1 with escalation, block-Baarda
unarmed) and adds ONE delta: network.congruence_screen.

wiring EXECUTES: station sweeps > 0, rows contracted > 0, and a per-station
MDB table at run end.  A clean log with zero station-sweeps would be the
live-counter-over-dead-wiring failure this card exists to make impossible.
The SPEC 7 field gates (OFF byte-identity on a graded lineage, the perturbed
arm, the converged-warm MDB table, the INC-3 co-occurrence) are still OWED
and none of them can be read off a 10-epoch cold start.
Pair with _congruence_smoke_off.json for the single-knob delta.
